description: A utility class for evaluating concept ranges and observations within the OpenMRS medical record system. It provides methods for evaluating criteria expressions, retrieving latest observations, calculating time intervals between observations, and handling date conversions.

classes.name: ConceptReferenceRangeUtility
classes.description: A utility class that evaluates concept ranges and observations for the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: evaluateCriteria
methods.description: Evaluates a criteria expression against an Obs object using Velocity templating.

methods.name: getLatestObs
methods.description: Retrieves the latest observation for a person based on a concept reference (UUID or code).

methods.name: getCurrentHour
methods.description: Returns the current hour of the day in 24-hour format.

methods.name: getLatestObsDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date of the latest observation for a given concept and person.

methods.name: isObsValueCodedAnswer
methods.description: Checks if the latest Obs's coded answer matches a specified concept reference.

methods.name: getObsDays
methods.description: Calculates days since the latest observation for a concept and person.

methods.name: getObsWeeks
methods.description: Calculates weeks since the latest observation for a concept and person.

methods.name: getObsMonths
methods.description: Calculates months since the latest observation for a concept and person.

methods.name: getObsYears
methods.description: Calculates years since the latest observation for a concept and person.

methods.name: getDaysBetween
methods.description: Calculates the number of days between two dates.

methods.name: getWeeksBetween
methods.description: Calculates the number of weeks between two dates.

methods.name: getMonthsBetween
methods.description: Calculates the number of months between two dates.

methods.name: getYearsBetween
methods.description: Calculates the number of years between two dates.

methods.name: getDays
methods.description: Calculates the number of days from a given date to the current date.

methods.name: getWeeks
methods.description: Calculates the number of weeks from a given date to the current date.

methods.name: getMonths
methods.description: Calculates the number of months from a given date to the current date.

methods.name: getYears
methods.description: Calculates the number of years from a given date to the current date.
